answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports the objective because it reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 provides strong evidence on enterprise conversion and pipeline quality, though it omits realized revenue and durability. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but omits margin, retention, and post-promotion sustainability. Memories 31 and 86 show durable or early-funnel product improvements without connecting them to qualified revenue. Memory 91 is weakest because it reports only short-term engagement and first-action effects, with no evidence on durability, revenue quality, retention, or monetization.
